items.title: The cycle of the zero scheme of a section is the sum over the components of the cycles of the restricted sections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the cycle of the zero scheme of a global section with the sum over the components of Y of the multiplicities times the cycles of the restricted sections, under the hypothesis that the section is injective at every generic point of the k-dimensional part of its zero scheme (statement lines 4357-4379, tag 0EPI). The proof is a local computation: it chooses a generator at the generic point of an integral Z so that the section becomes an element f of the local ring A, splits off the zero-dimensional case where injectivity forces f to be a unit, and in the one-dimensional case matches the length of A/(f) with the sum over the minimal primes of the local length times the length of A/(f, q_i). That matching is the substance, so the claim is H2.
